tools.name: mycashflow_list_orders
tools.description: List store orders, filterable by status and by created or updated date. Use it to find orders to review or ship. Returns one page; use page and page_size to read more. API: GET /v0/orders.

tools.name: mycashflow_get_order
tools.description: Get one order by its numeric id, with its products, customer, payments and status. API: GET /v0/orders/{orderID}.

tools.name: mycashflow_get_order_by_external_id
tools.description: Get one order by the external id that your shop or system set on it (for example a marketplace order number). API: GET /v0/orders/external-id={externalID}.

tools.name: mycashflow_list_order_shipments
tools.description: List the shipments of one order, with their status and tracking data. API: GET /v0/orders/{orderID}/shipments.

tools.name: mycashflow_list_products
tools.description: List products in the store, filterable by created or updated date. Returns one page; use page and page_size to read more. API: GET /v1/products.

tools.name: mycashflow_get_product
tools.description: Get one product by its numeric id, with its variations, options and visibility. API: GET /v1/products/{productID}.

tools.name: mycashflow_get_product_by_code
tools.description: Get one product by its product code (SKU as set in the store). API: GET /v1/products/product_code={productCode}.

tools.name: mycashflow_list_categories
tools.description: List the product categories of the store. API: GET /v1/categories.

tools.name: mycashflow_list_customers
tools.description: List customer accounts, filterable by created, updated or last login date. Customer data is personal data: request only what you need. API: GET /v1/customers.

tools.name: mycashflow_get_customer
tools.description: Get one customer account by its numeric id. API: GET /v1/customers/{customerID}.

tools.name: mycashflow_get_customer_by_email
tools.description: Get one customer account by its email address. API: GET /v1/customers/email={email}.

tools.name: mycashflow_list_stock
tools.description: List the stock items (balance per product), filterable by the update date. API: GET /v1/stock.

tools.name: mycashflow_get_stock_item
tools.description: Get the stock item of one product by its product code. API: GET /v1/stock/{productCode}.

tools.name: mycashflow_list_stock_changes
tools.description: List the stock movements, each with its balance change and reason. API: GET /v1/stock-changes.

tools.name: mycashflow_list_shipping_methods
tools.description: List the shipping methods the store offers. API: GET /v1/shipping-methods.

tools.name: mycashflow_list_payment_methods
tools.description: List the payment methods the store offers. API: GET /v1/payment-methods.

tools.name: mycashflow_add_order_comment
tools.description: Add a PRIVATE comment to an order. It is visible only to store admins and sends no email to the customer. Use it for internal notes. API: POST /v0/orders/{orderID}/comments.

tools.name: mycashflow_update_stock_balance
tools.description: Add to or subtract from the stock balance of one product by product code. Use a negative balance_change to subtract. Each call changes the live stock count. API: POST /v1/stock/{productCode}/update-balance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: mycashflow_list_orders, mycashflow_get_customer_by_email · Private data: mycashflow_add_order_comment · Public sink: mycashflow_get_customer_by_email, mycashflow_add_order_comment, mycashflow_update_stock_balance.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: mycashflow_list_orders, mycashflow_get_customer_by_email · Private data: mycashflow_add_order_comment · Public sink: mycashflow_get_customer_by_email, mycashflow_add_order_comment, mycashflow_update_stock_balance

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
